info.name: FoC User Service
info.description: Sign-up flow for the FoC User Service. Set baseUrl and signupEmail in an environment; the OTP arrives in Mailpit at http://localhost:8025. AI Assistance Disclosure: Tool: Claude Code (model: Claude Opus 5), date: 2026-09-26. Scope: generated the collection for the three sign-up routes. Author review: every request run against the compose stack.

request.description: 201 with the new userId and when the code expires. No users row exists yet. Read the code in Mailpit, then set the `otp` variable.
202. Replaces the code inside a sign-up that is still waiting, without extending its 15-minute window. 404 if nothing is pending; 429 after three requests in ten minutes.

exec: // Keeps the tokens in variables rather than in the file: nothing here is committed.

request.description: 200 with the auth response. The code is single-use, so replaying it gives OTP_EXPIRED.
